_comment: DRAFT placeholder tutorial texts (Demo 01 A0-A2), used only when narrative_manifest.json has no entry for the id (FNarrativeManifest::DraftTutorialTexts). To be replaced by the sheet Tutorial tab (TANDEM request 17). {key:<CommandId>} = the key cap, {focus} = the operative a 'focus' card is about.

WT_A0_BRIEFING_1.text: Cold Silence, this is HQ. Drop confirmed. You're on the ice, three klicks south of the Sector-17 weather station.

WT_A0_BRIEFING_2.text: Copy, HQ. Frost in the middle of summer... Somebody really doesn't want us here.

WT_A0_BRIEFING_3.text: The station went dark forty hours ago. Find out why. And keep moving — standing still on that ice will kill you.

WT_A0_01.text: Follow the beacons north. The fishermen marked the safe ice.

WT_A0_02.text: You heard him. Eyes open, one step at a time.

WT_A0_03.text: Minus thirty and dropping. Watch your hands — fingers go first.

WT_A0_04.text: Radio's dead. Not static — dead. Like something is eating the signal.

WT_A0_05.text: Then we do it the old way. Beacon one, twenty-five metres.

TUT_A0_CAM_PAN.title: CAMERA — MOVE
TUT_A0_CAM_PAN.text: Move the camera with {key:Camera.Pan.Keys} or by pushing the cursor to the screen edge.

TUT_A0_CAM_ROTATE_MOUSE.title: CAMERA — FREE LOOK
TUT_A0_CAM_ROTATE_MOUSE.text: Hold {key:Camera.Rotate.Mouse} and drag to turn the camera freely.

TUT_A0_MOVE.title: MOVE
TUT_A0_MOVE.text: Click the ground to move the squad. Head for the amber ring at beacon one.

TUT_A0_NOSPRINT.text: No running yet — save your strength.

OBJ_A1_CAMP.text: Follow the beacons to the fishing camp

OBJ_A1_HUT.text: Resupply heat packs at the fishermen's hut

WT_A1_01.text: Beacon one. The ice holds out here, we can pick up the pace.

WT_A1_02.text: Run where it's open, but nobody gets ahead of the squad.

WT_A1_03.text: Running keeps the blood moving. Stand still out here and the cold gets in fast.

TUT_A1_SELECT.title: SELECT
TUT_A1_SELECT.text: Press {key:Select.Member} (1 / 2 / 3) or click an operative to put him in the lead.

TUT_A1_BOX.title: SELECT A GROUP
TUT_A1_BOX.text: Hold the left mouse button and drag a box over several operatives to order them together.

WT_A1_HUT.text: A crate. Fishermen always keep something warm in there.

TUT_A1_LOOT_OPEN.title: SUPPLY CRATE
TUT_A1_LOOT_OPEN.text: Click the crate: the leader walks up and opens it.

TUT_A1_LOOT_TAKE.title: TAKE IT
TUT_A1_LOOT_TAKE.text: Take the heat packs: click their line in the crate window, or Take all.

WT_A1_04.text: Crack ahead. I'll check how far it runs — alone, quieter.

WT_A1_05.text: Go. We hold here, keep low.

WT_A1_06.text: Wind's stronger out on the edge. Won't be long.

TUT_A1_SOLO.title: SPLIT UP
TUT_A1_SOLO.text: Select the Engineer and press {key:Squad.Solo}: he scouts the crack alone, the others hold crouched where they stand.

TUT_A1_REGROUP.title: REGROUP
TUT_A1_REGROUP.text: Press {key:Squad.Regroup} again: the squad falls back into formation behind the leader.

WT_A1_GUST.text: Feel that gust? It goes straight through the coat.

TUT_A1_HEATPACK.title: HEAT PACK
TUT_A1_HEATPACK.text: {focus} is the coldest — past 40 % the shivering starts. Select him and press {key:Item.HeatPack} to crack his heat pack (or drag a mate's pack onto him in the inventory).

WT_A1_RESUPPLY.text: We're nearly out of heat packs. The fishermen's hut is close — let's check it.

TUT_A1_HEATPACK_MATE.title: HEAT PACK
TUT_A1_HEATPACK_MATE.text: {focus} is still freezing. Same again: select him and press {key:Item.HeatPack}, or drag a mate's heat pack onto him in the inventory.

WT_A1_STOCKED.text: Packs in the kit. That should hold us to the camp. Back to the beacons.

TUT_A1_SPRINT.title: RUN
TUT_A1_SPRINT.text: Double-click the ground to run. Running keeps you warm.

TUT_A2_HEATPACK.title: HEAT PACK
TUT_A2_HEATPACK.text: {focus} is freezing again. A heat pack works anywhere: {key:Item.HeatPack}, or drag it onto him in the inventory.

WT_A1_07.text: Formation. Close it up, eyes on the beacons.

WT_A1_08.text: Keep the gaps small. Nobody wanders off alone on this ice.

WT_A1_09.text: Beacon four next. The wind's picking up out there.

TUT_A1_GUARD.title: GUARD
TUT_A1_GUARD.text: Press {key:Squad.Guard}: the leader holds this spot while the others go on. Press it again to rejoin.

WT_A1_10.text: Get low. The wind cuts less down there.

WT_A1_11.text: Down if you have to. Crawl if you have to.

WT_A1_12.text: And remember — down low is also how you get under a wire.

TUT_A1_STANCE.title: STANCE
TUT_A1_STANCE.text: {key:Stance.Crouch} crouch, {key:Stance.Prone} prone, {key:Stance.Stand} stand. Hold Alt for the whole squad ({key:Stance.Squad.Prone}). Lower = less wind.

TUT_A1_VAULT.title: LOW RIDGE
TUT_A1_VAULT.text: Click the ground beyond the ridge: the squad climbs over low obstacles on its own.
